name: @pregen/verify
description: PRE-GEN client: sign requests and reports as a provider known by its domain (no account), and verify answers, proofs and the signed registry directory

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js && cd ../.. && python3 spec/conformance/level1/run_conformance.py --adapter "node packages/verify-js/test/conformance-adapter.js" --require-op canonical_json --require-op verify_signature --require-op verify_license --require-op verify_directory --require-op check_namespace

author: Valerii Egorov (Pastheroza)
